summary: Context-resume economy upgrade: DASHBOARD delta-read + mandatory prune + pipeline-state v2 structured head. ~95% fleet token reduction (~410k tokens/day). 3-phase implementation.

implementation_phases.label: SKILL + PRUNE — highest impact, low blast radius
actions: signal-dashboard SKILL § READ: replace full-file-read with Phase-1 mtime/linecount check + Phase-2 section-only read with start_line cache contract
signal-dashboard SKILL § WRITE: cap _Updated: to one line (ISO + agent-id + ≤8-word summary)
signal-dashboard SKILL § PRUNE: mark mandatory (not optional); note it must be called from drain-signals.md and cowork equivalents
drain-signals.md: add PRUNE call after step 0a-D row consumption
DASHBOARD.md: immediate prune pass — remove DONE/stale-READ rows; cap _Updated: header to one line

implementation_phases.label: pipeline-state.json v2 schema
actions: pipeline-state.json: restructure to v2 schema with head block (status_enum, active_task_id, next_agent, next_action ≤20 words, wip, wip_max, updated_at, updated_by) + dashboard_section_cache + narrative block (capped ≤30 lines). Migrate current prose content.
dev-team/flow/main.md Step 0b: read head.status / head.next_agent / head.active_task_id for routing only; narrative lazy-loaded only on explicit resume

implementation_phases.label: Cowork pipeline-state equivalents (optional follow-up)
files: any cowork agent pipeline-state-equivalent files with prose-blob anti-pattern
actions: Audit cowork agents for pipeline-state-equivalent prose blobs; apply v2 schema where found

constraints: NO branches — all work on main
SSOT discipline — signal-dashboard SKILL is the single SSOT for DASHBOARD protocol; one edit propagates to all callers without per-agent edits
Backward-compat — cache fields (last_mtime, last_linecount, start_line) are optional; absent = fall back to section read (no break)
pipeline-state v2 migration is self-healing — first writer detects _schema absent and upgrades
agent-md-factory rules apply to all .md edits
